title: 2026년 10월 31일, 인공지능 분야에서 무슨 일이 일어났을까요?
intro: AI developer tooling took the hits today: Wiz counts at least nine AI developer platforms breached in October, and EMBRACE found command-execution flaws in the built-in browsers of five coding tools.
Meanwhile inference keeps getting cheaper, with Anthropic tokens down 77% and prompt caching reaching up to 94% cache reads in one measured agent.
highlights: Wiz: at least nine AI developer platforms breached in October, driving LLMjacking.
EMBRACE: built-in browsers in five AI coding tools could run commands or read the disk.
Epoch: open-weight GLM 5.3 exploited six Firefox releases for about $1,000 each.
Prompt caching took one agent to up to 94% cache reads, about a quarter of the bill.
Apple Intelligence's Qwen access opens for testing in China on November 4.
